 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Rows and columns made entirely of the separator color divide the grid
    # into cells; mark cells containing more than one signal pixel.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, row_seps), spans(w, col_seps)
    bg = next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != sep and v != 1)
    signal = next((v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v not in (sep, bg, 1)), None)
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == signal for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if count > 1 else bg)
        result.append(row)
    return result
"
